About a quarter to a third of the role applies the same methods to operational and business questions. Routine operational reporting and dashboards sit outside this role. AI-assisted tools are part of how this role works every day, and the role is accountable for validating every result they help produce. The position has latitude to shape its own workflow and a potential path to expanded oversight of research-related functions.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:

• Write and execute statistical analysis plans for retrospective and real-world evidence studies, including target trial emulation. Define estimands (ICH E9(R1)), cohorts, exposure windows, and outcomes with the Chief Medical Officer and clinical investigators.

• Link and validate multi-table device data. Confirm denominators, person-time, and follow-up, and address left truncation and immortal time bias around device implant and remote monitoring enrollment.

• Respond to peer review: re-analyses, statistical sections of response letters, and defensible positions under methodological critique.

Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.
